scientific_queries.note: Cross-plate replication on the high-diversity design; no novelty claim.

subagent_note: None dispatched: eight comparisons with a matched control, reported per comparison with the underpowered arm labelled.

design.note: Layout pairs that share a cell line AND at least 20 compound pairs; a cross-cell control is measured on the same compound pairs.

underpowered_arm: H047 rests on only 2 comparisons with a file ceiling and those two point in opposite directions; its failure is a power problem, not evidence that plate effects are negligible.
interpretation: same cell across plates (0.851) agrees better than different cells on the same plate (0.750), so the cross-cell drops the program has measured cannot be mainly a plate/batch artefact

register_updates.F5: annotated: cross-batch testing is impossible on validation plates but possible on high-diversity plates (8 comparisons)
register_updates.C17: new, exploratory: cross-plate same-cell 0.851 vs same-plate cross-cell 0.750, difference +0.147 [+0.007,+0.301]

limitations: Only eight comparisons, each with 21-43 shared compound pairs; individual correlations are noisy.
The two layouts in each comparison come from different compound libraries, so the shared pairs may be a non-random subset.
No dose dimension in this design.
Exploratory: plates were used as scoring endpoints earlier and cells cross days.
